references.text: Jesus teaches in his hometown and meets wonder at his wisdom and power, which also happens in Mark 6:1-6 and Luke 4:22-30.
Mark's parallel to the event where Jesus teaches in his hometown and people wonder about the source of his wisdom and miracles.
Luke's account of Jesus teaching in Nazareth, where people marvel at his words and ask where his wisdom comes from.
The prophecy in Isaiah about the Lord's anointed who will proclaim good news, which can be seen as a foreshadowing of Jesus' teaching and miracles.
The psalm that speaks of speaking in parables and telling ancient, hidden things, which can be related to Jesus' way of teaching in Matthew 13.
